_source: GitLab CI/CD predefined variables, as a merge request pipeline sets them (rules: - if: $CI_PIPELINE_SOURCE == "merge_request_event"). GITLAB_CI 'true'; CI_PROJECT_PATH 'The project namespace with the project name included'; CI_MERGE_REQUEST_PROJECT_PATH 'The path of the project of the merge request' (merge request pipelines only); CI_MERGE_REQUEST_SOURCE_PROJECT_PATH; CI_SERVER_HOST 'without protocol or port'; CI_REPOSITORY_URL 'https://gitlab-ci-token:$CI_JOB_TOKEN@gitlab.example.com/my-group/my-project.git'. The fork case follows 'merge request pipelines': a fork MR 'is created and runs in the fork (source) project, not the parent (target) project'.
